decisions.reason: The illuminated arch with sound extends a familiar candle arch into electronics, so the firm can draw on existing arch know-how but faces moderate uncertainty in assimilating sound technology.
As a one-tier arched Christmas pyramid, this product is very close to the firm's core carving and assembly capabilities, making it easy to interpret and improve.
Although electronic, the interchangeable-disc music box is the stated flagship and builds on existing music-box knowledge, so the firm has likely invested in the necessary absorptive capacity.
The motif platform is a wooden accessory for the electronic music box, closely related to established woodworking and the flagship product, giving the firm strong related knowledge.
The Christmas motif platform similarly complements the music box line and uses the firm's established woodcraft, so it can be readily assimilated and improved.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid is a variation of the firm's traditional pyramid, well within existing knowledge and likely to be kept.
